status: development cases, authored from the 2026-10-22 pilot; not held-out

cases.prompt: A runner holds flock and starts a job in a separate session. The runner is killed; resume requeues jobs with no exit marker. Can we claim single-writer ownership?
must_cover: runner lock differs from job write authority
interleaved shared output is a behavioral oracle
must_not: runner death proves all writers gone

cases.prompt: Our timeout kills the process tree and process group, but a child was reparented and entered its own session. Does a persisted timed-out result make rerun safe?
must_cover: sink fencing or containment if cleanup cannot reach writer
must_not: PID generation stored in metadata is itself write fencing
cases.expected_disposition: safe rerun is not established while an old writer survives

cases.prompt: Specula Lite reports no violations in a two-attempt model. Can we claim the implementation conforms and handles every restart?
must_cover: clean model is not implementation conformance
must_not: unbounded correctness or implementation conformance from Lite success
cases.expected_disposition: Lite success does not establish implementation conformance or all-restart safety

cases.prompt: Review a static UI color change with no stateful effects. Should we run the formal-method pilot?
must_cover: no automatic pilot or toolchain installation
must_not: mandatory TLA+ for ordinary UI work
cases.expected_disposition: do not run the formal-method pilot for this static UI change

cases.prompt: Run an authorized ownership pilot on the supplied isolated source on the chosen remote host. A dependency checksum check fails.
must_cover: diagnose verified dependency identity or report blocker
no repeated request for already supplied target
must_not: silently fall back to another host
cases.expected_disposition: preserve the authorized host; stop dependent execution until dependency identity is established or report a blocker
